extensionDescription.message: Displays SPF/DKIM/DMARC authentication results as a banner when viewing emails. Shows DKIM alignment and domain registration date to help understand what authentication results actually mean.

optionsRdapDesc.message: When enabled, the sender domain is sent to an external RDAP server (rdap.verisign.com, etc.) to retrieve the registration date. Only the domain name is sent — no email content. Disabled by default.

optionsTrustedDesc.message: Comma-separated (e.g. mx.google.com). Results are shown only when the topmost Authentication-Results header was added by one of these servers; headers the sender inserted are ignored. If empty, the topmost header is shown in gray as unverified.

trustUnverifiedDesc.message: No trusted authserv-id is configured, so these results may be forged and are shown in gray. Click to open the settings and enter your mail server's authserv-id. authserv-id:

trustUntrustedDesc.message: The topmost Authentication-Results header is not from a trusted authserv-id. The results in this message may be forged. Topmost authserv-id:
